title: Provenance Record Contract
purpose: Defines the atomic framework-provenance record output artifact format for repository bootstrap.

normative_requirements.text: A bootstrap provenance record shall record the initializer identity and version, the local repo-spec framework repository actually used, the exact framework revision actually used, the initialization timestamp, and the canonical bootstrap request fingerprint.
The provenance record shall be a single UTF-8 encoded JSON object file written to `repo/initializer/provenance.json` in the staged and promoted repository.

The provenance representation shall define required fields `schema_version`, `initializer_name`, `initializer_version`, `framework_repository`, `framework_revision`, `initialization_timestamp`, and `request_fingerprint`; `framework_revision` shall conform to product.git-object-identity.

The provenance record shall set `schema_version` to the constant string `2`, write `initialization_timestamp` in ISO 8601 UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` format, and write the exact locally resolved framework revision as a canonical Git object identity.

The provenance `request_fingerprint` shall equal the SHA-256 fingerprint of the immutable canonical repository-bootstrap request and shall not be replaced by a separately supplied authority identifier.
The provenance record shall reject unknown fields, shall treat every declared field as required, and shall not contain a product identifier, product direction, or successor product authority.
The provenance record shall be deterministically serialized with keys in the declared field order, two-space indentation, and exactly one final newline.

The framework repository and revision recorded in provenance shall identify the exact local repo-spec commit tree from which installed framework material was read; inaccurate or ambiguous provenance shall fail closed before promotion.
